seed.description: Per-project PRNG seed. Prefer a random value persisted by BLA — never reuse legacy fixed fingerprints such as bla-shield-seed-v1.

weaveDecoys.description: Opt-in structural weave decoys (Python customer-def / .pyc co_consts weave; JS AST weave already on). Parity with CLI --weave-decoys / MCP weave_decoys.

selfSeal.description: Opt-in self-seal / sibling-module integrity binding for JS/Node targets (issue #40.5). Parity with CLI --self-seal / MCP self_seal.

wasmPreserveExports.description: WASM export names that must remain the public ABI when export rename runs at maximum/bankrupt (issue #40.3).
